title: Choir and Oath
author: Rafael Zhou
blurb: Casper Brightwater, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
